name: HiveMind
notes: Inspections now record drones and drone brood, each with its own box. Hands-free asks about them too.
Apiaries in more than one area? Pick one with the 📍 buttons at the top of the Bloom tab to see its bloom calendar.
Phone keeps mishearing a word? Settings › My words › Suggest sends it to the HiveMind team by email.
An apiary only needs a zip code (no street address), so a field or orchard works fine.
